parent_results: In r49, transverse third energy on both disjoint physical row banks at squared scale 2^-32 gives ||p_Q||inf<19036.747.
Every unpaid r49 grid state therefore has a one-sided total-cross rank-two alignment collar of Frobenius radius sqrt(2)2^-16.

sharpening.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate banks I,J, if Q=F(X_I)+2 X_I^T N X_J+b^T X_J with arbitrary measurable F, independent cap-one product inputs, and sigma2(N)>0, then Q has a density and ||p_Q||inf<=2sqrt(pi)/sigma2(N).
sharpening.proof_core: Condition on original X_I; Ball/Rogozin gives linear-form density <=sqrt(2)/||2N^T X_I+b||. Project this coefficient onto the top-two right singular plane, giving denominator >=2 sigma2 ||U_2^T X_I-y0||. The two-dimensional product projection density is <=2; bathtub gives E|Y-y0|^-1<=2sqrt(2pi).
sharpening.r49_application: If either principal side block of any r49 grid cell vanishes, then ||p_Q||inf<2sqrt(pi)/s_grid=1390.1568661610384<1391.

target_valid_obstruction: Flat Walsh rank-two pure crossing A=[[0,UV^T],[VU^T,0]] has spectrum {1,1,-1,-1}, rank-two global crossing, zero E3, individual edges O(1/m), leverage 2/m, and balanced half-bank cells each with sigma2=1/2. It refutes forcing a third cross direction or fixed edge, but is itself paid by the new theorem with ||p_Q||inf<=2sqrt(pi).
